test_title: PYST 28: SSC JE ME - Reasoning (Held on: 22 March 2021 (Evening)
subject: reasoning
question:
Select the option in which the words share the same relationship as that shared by the given pair of words.

Reptiles : Crocodiles
solution:
The logic follows here is:

All crocodiles are classified as reptiles. Because it gives eggs and its blood is cold.

Similarly,

All Tigers are classified as Mammal. Because it feeds milk to its child.

Rest options cannot satisfy this classification.

Hence, **"Mammals : Tigers"** is the correct answer.
